notes: No task-file write and no file write at all. --session is validated by ValidClaimToken before use (51-55). The hook's decode failure (66) and Encode result (84) are dropped on purpose: --stop-hook's documented contract is print-or-nothing and always exit 0, so a nudge that cannot be written must not wedge the session; there is no caller to propagate to. The _ = Encode predates 1.31.0 (ae0700cf); this task only changed its argument.

Test writes use 0o600 files and a 0o700 dir (226, 241, 347), paths built with filepath.Join under t.TempDir(); every runTP/json error is checked with require. The found-request refusal test (299-337) drives tp found add/apply through the CLI, so the task-file writes go through tp's own locked path.

Read-only: no write, so no lock is owed. Read failures fall back on purpose and are commented: an unreadable task file is skipped (125-128), an epic-graph error withholds ready tasks (fail-closed, 142), and an unreadable found store asks nothing (318-333; ReadFoundRequests returns ErrNotExist as empty and wraps parse errors with %w). Paths use filepath.Join/Rel (353-363); LandDirFor hashes the rel path, so no input reaches a path unescaped.

Pure assembly, no file write. BuildBrief propagates SelectPriorWork's error (548-551); --prior is range-checked (212-217). The found-task branch (564-568) reads no spec; ExtractSpecExcerptForTask returns an empty excerpt with a warning on an unreadable spec by its contract. renderFoundNotesText (726-744) only formats.

A planner with no I/O: PlanFoundApply returns a plan and the write happens in internal/cli (9b103671), outside this file. No error is produced or dropped here; the only discarded value is TouchesMatch's internal path.Match error in the callee, where a malformed glob simply does not match. Found ids come from strings.ToLower plus a numeric suffix and are never used as a path here.
Pure string build and parse, no I/O, no error path. A description not in apply's shape is shown whole instead of parsed (67-71), so a malformed description loses nothing.
The one fixture write uses 0o600 and filepath.Join under t.TempDir() (17-18); every BuildBrief and json.Marshal error is required.
